description: Test builds on a clean, throwaway Windows in Windows Sandbox (sandbox_start, sandbox_run, sandbox_screenshot, sandbox_collect, sandbox_stop, sandbox_status). Builds and tools mapped read-only, one writable out folder, network off by default, always stopped. Turn on only in a dedicated testing project: every agent in a project where it is on gets it. Requires Windows 11 Pro/Enterprise 24H2+ with the Windows Sandbox feature, and Node 18+.
